onFrame decrements timeToLaunch and calls launch() with random intervals (0.2-0.5 s or 0.7-2.2 s), sometimes launching two rockets. No input is needed.
Each rocket moves along an eased path while spawning white and gold trail particles each frame. At the apex explode() spawns 120-170 sparks plus a flash.
POOLS defines six colors (gold, red, blue, green, white, violet), and the rocket bag selects among them.

effects.bloom is added with threshold 0.65, and sparks use emissive materials with intensity 4-5. The probes show a non-blank, non-black frame with high variance.
